description: Turn messy text into clean JSON. Pass text plus a field `schema` or plain `instructions`; get a validated JSON object back. Uses the provider JSON mode. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

instructions.description: Optional plain-English extraction instructions (used if no schema).

schema.description: Optional map of field name → description of the value to extract.

text.description: Source text to extract from (required, up to ~16 KB).

name: agentbit.ai_extract
title: AI Extract (text → JSON)
